data.title: BTC surges as jobs report miss squashes Oct rate hike chances, nearing yearly high.
data.description: The latest jobs report missing expectations has significantly reduced the likelihood of an interest rate hike in October. The report revealed numbers that were below forecasts, leading many to believe that the possibility of a rate hike next month has diminished. At the same time, Bitcoin (BTC) is currently on the verge of reaching its highest point of the year. The cryptocurrency is showing strong momentum and is approaching the annual peak, indicating positive movement in its value.

data.title: CUPE 2484 members at Ideal Child Service Group preparing to strike Monday
data.description: Child care workers at Ideal Child Service Group (ICSG) in Toronto, represented by CUPE Local 2484, are gearing up to go on strike starting Monday, October 5 if the employer fails to resume negotiations for a fair collective agreement. These workers offer crucial care and education to children at five ICSG sites in the city. Their demands include fair wages, improved working conditions, and adequate resources to ensure high-quality child care services. The members of CUPE Local 2484 are adamant about securing their rights and are ready to take action if necessary.

data.title: Golden Gate Global Announces USCIS Approval of The Mammoth Collection, Its 17th Approved EB-5 Project in California
data.description: Golden Gate Global has revealed that The Mammoth Collection, an EB-5 project located in California's Greater Mammoth region, has gained approval from U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS), showcasing the company's flawless track record with a 100% USCIS project approval rate. This marks Golden Gate Global's 17th EB-5 project in California. The fully funded initiative supported the construction of a 101-key Residence Inn by Marriot.

data.title: 71% of UK finance leaders foresee tokenization reshaping financial services, with faster payments and settlement being key benefits: Lloyds survey.
data.description: A recent survey conducted by Lloyds revealed that the majority of respondents consider faster payments and settlement to be the most crucial advantages of tokenization. This comes at a time when the United Kingdom is focusing on developing the necessary infrastructure for tokenized finance.

data.title: HII Promotes Greg Ennis to Chief Financial Officer of Mission Technologies
data.description: In McLean, Virginia on October 02, 2026, it was reported that HII, trading on the NYSE under the symbol HII, has appointed Greg Ennis as the new senior vice president and CFO for its Mission Technologies division. Ennis will be responsible for managing the financial operations of the division, including accounting, financial reporting, planning and analysis, rates and budgets, and program cost control. This announcement signifies a significant advancement for Ennis within the company.

data.title: The NRP Group Announces Opening of Newly Constructed, 200-Unit Luxury Apartment Community One Webb Ave in Harrison, New York
data.description: In Harrison, New York, The NRP Group and RPW Group have unveiled One Webb Ave, a luxury multifamily community boasting 200 units. This development reflects a focus on sustainability, wellness, and connectivity in its design. Situated in Westchester County, this property promises residents a top-notch living experience.

data.title: LiveWire® S4 Honcho™ Meets Criteria for Motorcycle Safety Foundation® Rider Training Programs Opening a New Path Into Rider Training
data.description: In Milwaukee today, LiveWire (NYSE: LVWR) revealed that their S4 Honcho™ Street has been approved by the Motorcycle Safety Foundation (MSF) for use in rider training programs. The electric two-wheel industry leader's initiative marks a pivotal move towards enhancing rider education and aligns with LiveWire's objective of promoting accessibility and safety in motorcycling for upcoming riders. This development signifies a crucial advancement in catering to the needs and safety of a fresh wave of enthusiasts venturing into mobility journeys.

data.title: IDrive Business Offers Affordable, Comprehensive Cloud Backup to Help Small Businesses Safeguard Critical Data
data.description: On October 2, 2026, in Los Angeles, a prominent company in cloud backup and storage services, IDrive, is assisting small businesses in safeguarding their crucial business data through IDrive Business. This cost-effective cloud backup solution aims to streamline data protection for computers.
